Delivery & Order Tracking.description: Issues involving delayed, missing, or incorrectly tracked orders and delivery dates.
examples: The tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it

Returns & Refunds.description: Requests or problems involving product returns, refunds, seller refunds, and A-to-Z claims.
examples: I want to return this product
The seller received my return but hasn't refunded me
How do I get a refund?

Account & Access.description: Problems accessing or using an Amazon account, including locked accounts and verification or 2FA issues.
examples: I can't log into my account

Payment & Billing.description: Problems involving payments, charges, payment methods, billing, or Amazon Pay.
examples: Why do I need to revise my payment?

Product & Seller Issues.description: Questions or complaints about products, sellers, product authenticity, pricing, or seller behavior.
examples: The seller sent me a damaged product
Why did the product price change?
I have a problem with the seller

Technical / App Issues.description: Technical problems with Amazon websites, apps, media players, sign-up flows, or other digital services.
examples: I can't sign up for Amazon Music
The website keeps showing an error

Customer Service / Complaint.description: Complaints about support quality, repeated unresolved problems, poor service, or explicit escalation requests.
examples: I want to speak to a manager
I've contacted support several times with no solution

General / Other.description: Amazon-related questions that do not clearly belong to another defined intent.
examples: I have a question about Amazon
